business_problem: Fifth Dimension needed to process large commercial-real-estate deal datasets with long-context reasoning, secure centralized model access, and internal developer adoption without forcing engineers to manage separate vendor runtimes for Gemini and Claude.
solution_summary: Fifth Dimension expanded its Google Cloud estate into a multi-model document-processing platform that combines Gemini platform, Claude, and core data services. Gemini platform centralizes model inference securely and supports workflows that can last one to three hours while switching models at different phases. The team uses Gemini for large-scale document grouping and Claude for extraction and reasoning when working through deal datasets containing thousands of documents. Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL and Google Cloud Storage store relational and unstructured data, while BigQuery tracks analytics and usage. The same environment also improved internal engineering adoption, with engineers generating more than 300,000 lines of code monthly and accepting 98% of suggestions. This gives Fifth Dimension a governed way to route each stage of document intelligence to the best-fit model without rebuilding the platform per vendor.

data_flow: Large document sets are stored in Google Cloud Storage and Cloud SQL-backed application workflows, then orchestrated through Gemini platform. Gemini handles large-scale grouping, Claude performs extraction and reasoning, and BigQuery tracks analytics and usage across the platform.
business_outcome: Fifth Dimension processed larger deal datasets securely, improved internal engineering adoption, and gained the flexibility to use the best model at each phase of a complex commercial-real-estate workflow.
